notes.title: Galactic Federation Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/26b7bd742cc17153048918d2ffcbea86b3537203.jpg

The Galactic Federation Update HAS ARRIVED! — a cosmic celebration based on humankind's euphoric feel with space! The 'Galactic Federation' is based on a space security chief's reports about alleged contact with extraterrestrials!

Starting today, 10th May 2022 - 8:00PM (GMT+2), you will discover multiple new space-themed items, a new map, a reworking of several items, and MORE!

The space-themed background and music will be removed on 30th May 2022. Everything else will remain permanently!

New space-themed items
- Stickman Skins: Mantis + Pleiadian + Astronaut
- Weapon: Plasma Gun
- Throwable: Zapper
- Headgear: Third Eye

Lobby redesigned into a space theme
The game's Lobby will be temporarily redesigned to feature space-themed items.

A new BS1-inspired map
The Ancient Tower - a map based on a similar one in BattleStick (first version)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38657380/3474d1a9bc17237bd82600e05ee2ac0bc5215b06.png

...and MORE!
Halloween stickman skins, Heart Glasses, Stickiller's Fireworks Launcher are now permanently available. Also, redesigned the Ice Plains map by removing the 'corridors', reworked all melee weapons by increasing their range by 5px... and more changes can be found in the following changelog:

[code]- Added new CP map : The Ancient Tower (inspired by BS1)
- Added new stickman skins : Mantis, Pleiadian + Astronaut. Note: Halloween stickman skins are now permanently available
- Added new weapon : Plasma Gun
- Added new throwable : Zapper
- Added new headgear: Third Eye
- Added Technical FAQ : contains the commonly asked technical issues
- Returned Heart Glasses + Stickiller's Fireworks Launcher: now permanently available
- Redesigned Ice Plains : removed the 'corridors'
- Reworked melee weapons : increased range by 5px
- Reworked Javeline : fixed hitbox
- Reworked Magic Wand : removed wand's self-damage
- Reworked Gravitational Bomb : reworked the attractor's force
- Reworked Stickiller : reworked explosion effect for the Firework Launcher skin + fixed a bug where previously when you shot at the ground below you were pulled to the explosion.
- Reworked Leaderboard : increased number of results from 20 to 50
- Reworked camera : increased maximum zoom
- Reworked Chat System : Lobby chat is now visible while in-game. Use /l to type in battle + renamed (ROOM) chat to (BATTLE)
- Removed Wiki button and all its links in Shop
- Disabled Xsolla Diamonds Shop[/code]
See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: New Year's Eve Letter + Update!
notes.notes:
Stickmen!

It's been a great year for the BattleStick 2 community, a year of the release of BS2, highlighting vast differences compared to BattleStick.

BattleStick 2 was created with the intention of modernizing 2D graphics by upgrading to Phaser 3, learning from some technical and marketing mistakes, and of course adding more features. It took about 9 months of development till the Closed Beta Testing release on 24th April 2020, and the final revised Steam release on 24th September 2020.

While still being a relatively small community and not growing at an accelerated rate, the game is steadily growing, showing no major signs of slowing down.

We acknowledge our mistakes in areas such as balancing items and performance issues, but together we managed to resolve many of them thanks to your dedicated feedback!

Our efforts are focused on the usual of adding new items, fixing bugs, balancing issues, and making the game grow. We will be publishing gameplay videos on the BS1 and BS2 YouTube channels soon.

[CHANGELOG] V2.1.0 — NEW YEAR'S EVE PATCH
[code]- Added new headgear : New Year's Hat
- Reworked Daggers : increased damage inflicted from 125 to 145[/code]
The staff of BattleStick 2 wish you prosperity throughout the coming year of 2021. Thank you for your support in keeping the game going on!

notes.title: [CHANGELOG] V2.0.2
notes.notes:
Hey Stickmen!

Changelog V2.0.2 is out now! 

We have added a new Brigida weapon skin : Oak Staff; reworked physics : even if the player dies, the projectile(s) and throwable(s) now continue their trajectory; reworked Desert Deep.

The full changelog:

[code]- Added new Brigida weapon skin : Oak Staff
- Added a system which shows a red ribbon with "NEW" text under recently released items
- Renamed "Prehistoric Bomb" to "Explosive Bomb"
- Reworked physics : even if the player dies, the projectile(s) and throwable(s) now continue their trajectory. Previously they were destroyed
- Reworked Conquer Points : conquered flag message is now based on team color. Previously it was green
- Redesigned Desert Deep
- Reworked Stickiller : AOE is now 35
- Fixed no respawn issue where previously sometimes a player couldn't respawn [/code]
See you on the battlefield!
